```{r}
Folder <- "Ctrl_Antibody"
Subset <- "CD8"

StorageLocation <- file.path("outputs", Folder, Subset)
DownsampledFolder <- file.path(StorageLocation, "Downsampled")
if (!dir.exists(DownsampledFolder)){dir.create(DownsampledFolder)}

CoerebaFolder <- file.path(StorageLocation, "Coereba")
if (!dir.exists(CoerebaFolder)){dir.create(CoerebaFolder)}

OutputLocation <- CoerebaFolder
```

```{r}
fcs_files <- list.files(StorageLocation,
 pattern=".fcs", full.names=TRUE)

UnmixedCytoSet <- load_cytoset_from_fcs(fcs_files,
 truncate_max_range=FALSE, transformation=FALSE)

UnmixedGatingSet <- GatingSet(UnmixedCytoSet)
```

```{r}
TheName <- paste0(Subset, "Gates.csv")
FinalSplitpointsPath <- file.path(OutputLocation, TheName)
FinalSplitpoints <- read.csv(FinalSplitpointsPath, check.names=FALSE)
```

## Metadata

Check the current metadata status.

```{r}
pData(UnmixedGatingSet)
```

```{r}
Bid <- function(filename) {
  bid <- str_extract(filename, "INF\\d{3}")
  bid <- data.frame(bid, check.names=FALSE)
}

Condition <- function(filename) {
  Condition <-str_extract(filename, "(?<=INF\\d{3}-)[A-Za-z]+(?=_Antibody)")
  Condition  <- data.frame(Condition, check.names=FALSE)
}

Experiment <- function(filename) {
  Experiment <- str_extract(filename, "ILT_\\d{2}")
  Experiment <- data.frame(Experiment, check.names=FALSE)
}
```

```{r}
pd <- pData(UnmixedGatingSet)

Names <- pd |> pull(name)

TheNames <- pd
TheBID <- map(.x=Names, .f=Bid) |> bind_rows()
TheCondition <- map(.x=Names, .f=Condition) |> bind_rows()
TheExperiment <- map(.x=Names, .f=Experiment) |> bind_rows()

TheIntermediate <- bind_cols(TheNames, TheBID, TheCondition, TheExperiment)
```

```{r}
TheMetadata <- file.path("data", "Metadata.csv")
TheMetadataDF <- read.csv(TheMetadata, check.names=FALSE)
AddThisMetada <- TheMetadataDF |> select(bid, ptype, infant_sex)
UpdatedMetadata <- left_join(TheIntermediate, AddThisMetada, by="bid")
rownames(UpdatedMetadata) <- rownames(pd)

pData(UnmixedGatingSet) <- UpdatedMetadata
```

```{r}
#| eval: FALSE
pData(UnmixedGatingSet) |> View()
```

## Transformation

Proceed to transform and visualize your data to ensure that everything looks okay before proceeding.

```{r}
#| label: "Biexponential Transformation"
#| message: false
Markers <- colnames(UnmixedCytoSet)
KeptMarkers <- Markers[-grep("Time|FS|SC|SS|Original|-W$|-H$|AF", Markers)]
MarkersForToday <- KeptMarkers

Biexponential <- flowjo_biexp_trans(channelRange=4096, maxValue=4194304,
     pos=5.62, neg=1, widthBasis=-1000)
TransformList <- transformerList(KeptMarkers, Biexponential)
UnmixedGatingSet <- transform(UnmixedGatingSet, TransformList)
```

# Creating SummarizedExperiment

```{r}
#| eval: TRUE
Metadata <- UpdatedTidyedCopy |>
     dplyr::select("bid", "ptype", "infant_sex", "Experiment", "Condition") |> unique()
rownames(Metadata) <- NULL
#Metadata <- Metadata |> mutate(TheIdentity=paste(Specimen, ptype, Timepoint, Island, sep="_"))
```

```{r}
#| label: Panel Information

Example <- read.FCS(fcs_files[1], transformation=FALSE, truncate_max_range = FALSE)
#Example <- CoerebaFlowFrame[[1]]

TheColumns <- flowWorkspace::markernames(Example)
Fluorophore <- names(TheColumns)
Fluorophore <- gsub("-A", "", Fluorophore)

ThePanel <- data.frame(Fluorophore, check.names=FALSE)

ThePanel <- ThePanel |> 
  mutate(Fluorophore = case_when(
    Fluorophore == "PE-Vio770" ~ "PE-Vio 770",
    Fluorophore == "PE-Dazzle594" ~ "PE-Dazzle 594",
    TRUE ~ Fluorophore
  ))

ThePanel <- ThePanel |>  mutate(
    Detector = map_chr(Fluorophore, \(f) Luciernaga::DetectorGuess(x = f, NumberDetectors = 64))
  )

ThePanel <- ThePanel |> 
  mutate(Marker = TheColumns)

DetectorOrder <- c("UV1", "UV2", "UV3", "UV4", "UV5", "UV6", "UV7", "UV8",
               "UV9", "UV10", "UV11", "UV12", "UV13", "UV14", "UV15", "UV16",
               "V1", "V2", "V3", "V4", "V5", "V6", "V7", "V8",
               "V9", "V10", "V11","V12", "V13", "V14", "V15", "V16",
               "B1", "B2", "B3", "B4", "B5", "B6", "B7", "B8",
               "B9", "B10", "B11", "B12", "B13", "B14",
               "YG1", "YG2", "YG3", "YG4", "YG5", "YG6", "YG7", "YG8", "YG9", "YG10",
               "R1", "R2", "R3", "R4", "R5", "R6", "R7", "R8")

ThePanel$Detector <- factor(ThePanel$Detector, levels=DetectorOrder)

ThePanel <- ThePanel |> arrange(Detector) |> select(-Detector)
```

```{r}
#| label: Coereba_Processing
#| eval: FALSE

TheBioconductor <- Coereba_Processing(x=Goodbye,
 panel=ThePanel, themetadata=Metadata,
 metadata_columns=c("bid", "ptype", "infant_sex", "Experiment", "Condition"),
 SpecimenVariable="bid")
```

```{r}
library(SummarizedExperiment)

TheBioconductor@elementMetadata |> dim()
keep <- rowData(TheBioconductor)$ZombieNIR == 0
keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE

SmallerBioconductor <- TheBioconductor[keep, ]
SmallerBioconductor@elementMetadata |> dim()

keep <- rowData(SmallerBioconductor)$PacificBlue == 0
keep[is.na(keep)] <- FALSE

CleanBioconductor <- SmallerBioconductor[keep, ]
CleanBioconductor@elementMetadata |> dim()
```

```{r}
se <- CleanBioconductor

is_HU <- colData(se)$ptype == "HEU-hi"
is_HU[is.na(is_HU)] <- FALSE

mat <- assay(se, "count")

in_HU    <- rowSums(mat[, is_HU,  drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
in_other <- rowSums(mat[, !is_HU, drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0

keep <- in_HU & !in_other

table(keep)
se_HU_only <- se[keep, ]
se_HU_only

mat  <- assay(se_HU_only)               # or assay(se_HU_only, "yourAssayName")
expt <- colData(se_HU_only)$Experiment

# Per cluster x experiment: TRUE if detected in any sample of that experiment
by_expt <- sapply(split(seq_along(expt), expt), function(idx) {
  rowSums(mat[, idx, drop = FALSE] > 0, na.rm = TRUE) > 0
})

# Number of distinct experiments each cluster appears in
n_expt <- rowSums(by_expt)

keep <- n_expt > 3

table(keep)
se_HU_multi <- se_HU_only[keep, ]
se_HU_multi
```
